mapper.sql: select workorder_id, workorder_code, plan_id, plan_no, workorder_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, bom_id, route_id, route_name, plan_quantity, completed_quantity, qualified_quantity, defective_quantity, scrap_quantity, status, priority, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, actual_start_time, actual_end_time, workshop_id, workshop_name, team_id, team_name, estimated_hours, actual_hours, client_id, client_name, sales_order_no, remark, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time from pro_workorder
mapper.insert: insert into pro_workorder ( workorder_code, plan_id, plan_no, workorder_type, item_id, item_code, item_name, specification, bom_id, route_id, route_name, plan_quantity, priority, plan_start_time, plan_end_time, workshop_id, workshop_name, team_id, team_name, estimated_hours, client_id, client_name, sales_order_no, remark, create_by, create_time, status ) values ( #{workorderCode}, #{planId}, #{planNo}, #{workorderType}, #{itemId}, #{itemCode}, #{itemName}, #{specification}, #{bomId}, #{routeId}, #{routeName}, #{planQuantity}, #{priority}, #{planStartTime}, #{planEndTime}, #{workshopId}, #{workshopName}, #{teamId}, #{teamName}, #{estimatedHours}, #{clientId}, #{clientName}, #{salesOrderNo}, #{remark}, #{createBy}, sysdate(), 'PENDING' )
mapper.delete:
delete from pro_workorder where workorder_id in
#{workorderId}
mapper.update:
update pro_workorder set status = #{status},
actual_start_time = sysdate(),
actual_end_time = sysdate(),
update_time = sysdate() where workorder_id = #{workorderId}
mapper.select: select sum(case when status = 'PENDING' then 1 else 0 end) as pending, sum(case when status = 'RELEASED' then 1 else 0 end) as released, sum(case when status = 'PRODUCING' then 1 else 0 end) as producing, sum(case when status = 'COMPLETED' then 1 else 0 end) as completed, sum(case when status = 'CLOSED' then 1 else 0 end) as closed, count(*) as total, sum(case when status in ('PENDING', 'RELEASED', 'PRODUCING') and plan_end_time < date_add(now(), interval 1 day) then 1 else 0 end) as delayed from pro_workorder where status != 'CLOSED' or (status = 'CLOSED' and update_time > date_sub(now(), interval 30 day))

select w.workorder_id as workorderId, w.workorder_code as workorderCode, w.item_name as itemName, w.specification, w.plan_quantity as planQuantity, w.completed_quantity as completedQuantity, w.qualified_quantity as qualifiedQuantity, w.defective_quantity as defectiveQuantity, w.status, w.priority, w.plan_start_time as planStartTime, w.plan_end_time as planEndTime, w.actual_start_time as actualStartTime, w.actual_end_time as actualEndTime, w.workshop_name as workshopName, w.team_name as teamName, round(ifnull(w.completed_quantity / w.plan_quantity * 100, 0), 1) as progress, case when w.status in ('PENDING', 'RELEASED', 'PRODUCING') and w.plan_end_time < date_add(now(), interval 1 day) then timestampdiff(day, w.plan_end_time, now()) else 0 end as delayDays from pro_workorder w where w.status != 'CLOSED' or (w.status = 'CLOSED' and w.update_time > date_sub(now(), interval 7 day)) order by case w.status when 'PRODUCING' then 1 when 'RELEASED' then 2 when 'PENDING' then 3 when 'COMPLETED' then 4 else 5 end, w.priority = 'HIGH' desc, w.plan_end_time asc

select w.workorder_id as workorderId, w.workorder_code as workorderCode, w.item_name as itemName, w.plan_end_time as planEndTime, timestampdiff(day, w.plan_end_time, now()) as delayDays from pro_workorder w where w.status in ('PENDING', 'RELEASED', 'PRODUCING') and w.plan_end_time < date_add(now(), interval 1 day) order by w.plan_end_time asc
